in_marathi.name: अर्जुन
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Brave, Invincible, Man of War
in_marathi.long_meaning: अर्जुन हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Arjuna is a revered name from Hindu mythology, derived from the Sanskrit word 'Arjuna' which means 'Brave, Invincible, Man of War'. In the Mahabharata epic, Arjuna is the greatest warrior and a central character. He is Krishna's most beloved disciple and is known for his unwavering devotion and courage.

in_bengali.long_meaning: अर्जुन একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Arjuna is a revered name from Hindu mythology, derived from the Sanskrit word 'Arjuna' which means 'Brave, Invincible, Man of War'. In the Mahabharata epic, Arjuna is the greatest warrior and a central character. He is Krishna's most beloved disciple and is known for his unwavering devotion and courage.
